title: Refreshing Melon and Ceviche Salad
description: A light and refreshing salad perfect for hot summer days, combining the sweetness of melons with the tanginess of ceviche.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine diced melon and ceviche.
Squeeze the juice of 2 tablespoons of jazzy citrus over the top of the melon mixture.
Sprinkle a pinch of portuguese sea salt to taste.
Garnish with chopped fresh mint leaves.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Just before serving, give the salad a gentle stir and adjust the seasoning if needed.
